title: Is Svalbard getting warmer?
teaser: Air temperature in Longyearbyen, a town in the high Arctic, from 1981 to 2025. This case shows what a clear, significant trend looks like.

title: Are winters in Siberia changing?
teaser: Winters in Novosibirsk can be mild one year and bitterly cold the next. This exploratory seasonal case shows large year-to-year swings. Seasonal inference has not been validated, so its rate is descriptive and significance is unavailable.

title: Rain in Athens and Helsinki
teaser: Climate studies often expect the Mediterranean to get drier and northern Europe to get wetter. We chose these two cities for that reason before looking at any result, and kept them whatever the data showed.
